## Zhiquan Chen

Welcome to my website. My work in P8105 at Columbia University focuses on
organizing data, writing reproducible analyses, and communicating results
through clear visualizations.

This website brings together my course projects and an interactive exploration
of New York weather observations.

- [Resume and selected projects](resume.html)
- [Interactive weather dashboard](dashboard.html)
- [GitHub profile](https://github.com/Chenzq2333)

The weather dashboard uses daily observations from one weather station in 2010.
You can hover over the plots to inspect values, zoom into a region, and compare
temperature patterns across months.
